title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Failed-Draft Reference: Retries, Re-presentment, Suspension Codes and Return Windows
content:
Reference figures of the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization for drafts that do not collect. Day counts are calendar days unless marked as banking days.

### A. Retries, re-presentment and the consecutive-failure count

| Method | Declined card draft retried | Days between failed draft and retry | Retries after the first attempt, per due date | ACH draft returned for insufficient or uncollected funds presented again | Times one returned entry may be presented again | Consecutive due dates without a successful draft that suspend AutoPay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | Yes | 3 | 2 | No | 0 | 2 |
| Credit Card | Yes | 3 | 2 | No | 0 | 2 |
| Personal Checking ACH | No | 3 | 0 | Yes | 1 | 2 |
| Personal Savings ACH | No | 3 | 0 | Yes | 1 | 2 |
| Business Checking ACH | No | 3 | 0 | Yes | 2 | 3 |
| Business Card | Yes | 3 | 2 | No | 0 | 3 |

Card methods retry a declined draft up to 2 times, 3 days apart, and never re-present; the bank methods do not retry declines but re-present an insufficient- or uncollected-funds return: once on the personal bank methods, up to 2 times on Business Checking ACH. AutoPay is suspended after 2 consecutive failed due dates on the personal methods and 3 on the business methods.

### B. Declines and returns that suspend at once, and returns that mean the authorization is disputed

| Method | Suspend AutoPay at once | Mean the tenant disputes authorizing the draft |
|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | card closed; card lost or stolen; unauthorized chargeback | unauthorized chargeback |
| Credit Card | card closed; card lost or stolen; unauthorized chargeback | unauthorized chargeback |
| Personal Checking ACH | R02 account closed; R03 no account; R07 authorization revoked; R10 not authorized | R07 authorization revoked; R10 not authorized |
| Personal Savings ACH | R02 account closed; R03 no account; R07 authorization revoked; R10 not authorized | R07 authorization revoked; R10 not authorized |
| Business Checking ACH | R02 account closed; R03 no account; R29 corporate not authorized | R29 corporate not authorized |
| Business Card | card closed; card lost or stolen; unauthorized chargeback | unauthorized chargeback |

### C. Return and chargeback windows

| Method | Ordinary ACH return window (banking days after settlement) | Unauthorized-debit return window (calendar days after settlement) | Chargeback window (calendar days after the card draft) | Banking calendar |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | 0 | 0 | 120 | None (cards) |
| Credit Card | 0 | 0 | 120 | None (cards) |
| Personal Checking ACH | 2 | 60 | 0 | Federal Reserve banking days |
| Personal Savings ACH | 2 | 60 | 0 | Federal Reserve banking days |
| Business Checking ACH | 2 | 2 | 0 | Federal Reserve banking days |
| Business Card | 0 | 0 | 120 | None (cards) |

Card methods show 0 for both ACH return windows and a 120-day chargeback window. Bank methods show 0 for the chargeback window, a 2-banking-day ordinary return window on the Federal Reserve calendar, and an unauthorized-debit window of 60 calendar days on the personal bank methods and 2 on Business Checking ACH.

### Quick reading (hypothetical)

On Business Checking ACH, an entry returned for insufficient funds may be presented again up to 2 times; a return coded R29 suspends the authorization at once and marks the draft as disputed; a return coded R10 is not on that method's list.
